commission_and_net_r.commission: subtract exactly one round-turn commission for TP, SL, and TIME
commission_and_net_r.pf_definition: sum(net_R where net_R > 0) / abs(sum(net_R where net_R < 0)); positive with no losses is +inf
commission_and_net_r.spread: embedded once in scenario BID/ASK path

entry_time.maximum_wait_after_confirmation: already frozen: first valid opening quote among confirm_time +1, +2, or +3 minutes
entry_time.on_missing_or_mismatch: hard fail; never drop, delay, or replace an event after authorization
entry_time.required_source_quote: finite positive open_bid and open_ask, with open_ask >= open_bid, at frozen entry_time

horizon.missing_quote_at_deadline: wait only for the first valid source opening BID/ASK quote at or after the deadline; first apply adverse-stop and favorable-target gap rules, otherwise execute TIME at scenario open
horizon.normal_timeout: market exit at first valid executable scenario quote at or after entry_time + 120 minutes

bar_evaluation_order: evaluate stop and target range touches
if both are touched, assign SL
otherwise assign the single touched boundary
intrabar_and_gap_rules.gap_beyond_target: TP at target, with no favorable price improvement
intrabar_and_gap_rules.long_gap_beyond_stop: SL at scenario BID open, even if worse than stop
intrabar_and_gap_rules.short_gap_beyond_stop: SL at scenario ASK open, even if worse than stop

risk.required: finite and strictly positive for every event and scenario

scenario_quotes.long_entry_price: scenario ASK open at frozen entry_time
scenario_quotes.short_entry_price: scenario BID open at frozen entry_time

sigma60_for_structural_stop.causality: robust_sigma60 is shifted by one M1 and therefore uses only information available before the confluence/contact minute
sigma60_for_structural_stop.invalid_value_action: hard fail; event may not be removed
sigma60_for_structural_stop.reason_for_v1_1_correction: rzr.contacts.find_first_contacts stores sigma60 at contact, rzr.entries_v1.build_entry uses rec['sigma60'], and the causal rebuild protocol states that the completion anchor supplies sigma and approach state
sigma60_for_structural_stop.semantic_role: sigma carried by the execution anchor at the causal completion contact

conditions: event rows and event IDs exact
same events for all four scenarios and six RR
all frozen preoutcome causal violation counters remain zero
V1.1 protocol and authorization hashes exact

D_temporal.annual_contribution_share_definition: abs(annual sum net_R) / sum(abs(all annual sums net_R))

F_single_position_portfolio.rule: select earliest event; ignore every later entry with entry_time <= active exit_time; continue after exit
F_single_position_portfolio.selected_trade_count: mandatory diagnostic; no post-outcome pass/fail threshold

governance.exact_deterministic_reproduction_after_o: allowed; rules and population may not change
governance.fail_action: close this core as an economic candidate on 2011-2025; subgroup tables may generate independently preregistered hypotheses only
governance.pass_authorizes: external broker/feed replication and prospective validation only
governance.retry_before_any_outcome_read: allowed only for infrastructure failure with identical hashes and code

actual_bid_ask_role: verification of the frozen entry opening quote
market_data.annual_input_hashes: verify exactly against the frozen preoutcome manifest
market_data.execution_cost_overlay_role: scenario-standardized synthetic BID/ASK around frozen source mid OHLC; actual source spread is not added again
market_data.mid_ohlc_definition: stored source mid OHLC, arithmetic mean of matching source BID and ASK OHLC
market_data.source: same already-used public Dukascopy XAUUSD M1 BID/ASK monthly files

post_outcome_prohibitions: no session, NY_AM, London, or session-transition rescue
no M15, M30, or H1 rescue
no DOZ_BODY, DOZ_LAST, or DOZ_BASE rescue
no cost, stop, horizon, entry, target, or ambiguity-rule change

additional_v1_1_checks: every event confluence_idx maps exactly to frozen confluence_time
sigma60 at frozen confluence_idx is finite and strictly positive
entry-time sigma is not used by the structural-stop calculation
all four scenarios use the same confluence sigma for the same event

date_cluster_bootstrap.resample_rule: sample dates with replacement; carry every event on a selected date with that date's multiplicity; recompute the event-weighted surface mean

primary_endpoint.date_equal_weight_surface_mean: mandatory secondary diagnostic only; never changes the primary verdict
primary_endpoint.date_role_clarification: trading date is the dependence cluster for inference; the primary point estimate remains event-weighted to preserve mean R per trade
primary_endpoint.event_level_surface_score: arithmetic mean of the six net_R values for the same frozen event
primary_endpoint.name: CAUSAL_CORE_RR_SURFACE_MEAN_NET_R
primary_endpoint.point_estimate: arithmetic mean of the 498 event-level surface scores
primary_endpoint.trading_date_definition: America/New_York trading date with a 17:00 boundary derived from entry_time

secondary_endpoints.per_rr_cells: N, mean net_R, sum net_R, PF, TP%, SL%, TIME%, same-bar ambiguity%, and date-cluster CI for every scenario and RR
secondary_endpoints.rr15_role: descriptive only for temporal, concentration, drawdown, and portfolio checks

supersedes_before_outcome.reason: V1 changed the frozen structural-stop volatility input from sigma60 at the causal confluence/anchor contact to sigma60 at entry. V1.1 restores the historical and rebuild-protocol rule before any outcome is opened.
